children: Overview
Ireland energy metals explorer's H1 net loss widened to €947,000 on share option charge
Company completed acquisition of 85% of Namibia Uranium, expanding uranium exploration portfolio
Cash at 30 June 2026 was €1.07 mln, fully funding current exploration programmes
Outlook
Arkle says immediate focus is on assay results from Namibia drilling, expected within 20 days
Company says results will shape next phase of work on Erongo licences
Arkle says current exploration programmes are fully funded for the rest of 2026
Result Drivers
NAMIBIA ACQUISITION - Co completed acquisition of 85% of Namibia Uranium, adding four uranium prospecting licences and expanding exploration portfolio
EXPLORATION ACTIVITY - Phase 1 exploration in Namibia completed ahead of schedule, with airborne and ground geophysics, trenching, and drilling identifying uranium targets
SHARE OPTION CHARGE - Net loss included €455,000 non-cash share option charge following new grants to directors and management
